A really fun project led by @KaiTyrusNelson, @tobykreiman: use simulated experiments to create a prior with state information, then align it to real-world experiments (with partial observation). Oddly enough, the theoretical foundations have a lot in common with inverse RL!

1/ A grand challenge in science: the simulation-to-experiment gap\
\
Simulators model complex systems but introduce model errors; experiments give real-world data but are costly and noisy\
\
Can we leverage both? Yes! We introduce Adversarial Distribution Alignment (ADA), at https://t.co/bl7o04xc45
